title: 7 free tools for game stories, novels and scripts
author: BuffaloConscious7919
selftext:
ffvii scenes still come up at the most random of moments and sit with me whilst i blissfully reminisce 1) the shock and sadness of the Ariel scene 2) how easy life was at that time 3) how important these memories are

my side quest is about folding in all the elements of games i loved playing as a kid . ffvii & zelda audio, super smash bros gameplay, tekken character movements etc. etc. and after making a lot of the visuals, core loop, sfx and music i started working on perhaps the most important part... the story

i'm trying out different tool and here's a list of free, open-source writing tools i'm trying and might be useful

any tips ? good or bad experiences with writing tools?

comments.author: BuffaloConscious7919
comments.body:
repos / links for anyone that wants to check them out:

1. \[Twine\]([https://github.com/klembot/twinejs](https://github.com/klembot/twinejs)) — make a click-to-choose branching story in the browser, with almost no code. (2,964 stars)
2. \[novelWriter\]([https://github.com/vkbo/novelWriter](https://github.com/vkbo/novelWriter)) — keep a novel's chapters and notes organised as the manuscript grows. (3,254 stars)
3. \[Manuskript\]([https://github.com/olivierkes/manuskript](https://github.com/olivierkes/manuskript)) — plan characters, places and plot on index cards before you write the prose. (2,484 stars)
4. \[ink\]([https://github.com/inkle/ink](https://github.com/inkle/ink)) — write a more structured interactive story in Inky, inkle's editor. (5,036 stars)
5. \[Yarn Spinner\]([https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner](https://github.com/YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner)) — write game dialogue like a script, then use it in Unity or Godot later. (2,878 stars)
6. \[Starc\]([https://github.com/story-apps/starc](https://github.com/story-apps/starc)) — write a screenplay in the usual script layout on your computer, with no subscription. (431 stars)
7. \[Better Fountain\]([https://github.com/piersdeseilligny/betterfountain](https://github.com/piersdeseilligny/betterfountain)) — write a screenplay in VS Code or Cursor, if that is already your editor. (454 stars)
